newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BARNSLEY WIN FIRST PREMIERSHIP POINTS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARNSLEY WIN FIRST PREMIERSHIP POINTS.

text.p: Neil Redfearn, weekend scorer of the first top flight goal in Barnsley's 110-year history, found the net again at Crystal Palace on Tuesday to give the northern English club an initial premier league win.

The former Palace player hit a left-footed shot into the top right corner of goal from 25 metres in the 56th minute to give Barnsley a 1-0 win at Selhurst Park in a clash between the two newly-promoted teams.
Palace's new Italian signing Attilio Lombardo made his home debut to loud applause and with some deft touches.
But his team, who would have headed the table after two matches had they won, had an unlucky night with shots bouncing off the post and bar in the second half.
